changes_from_v3: Missed-opportunity feedback no longer treats the ordinal six-stage index as market direction.
A flat WAIT is penalized only when BRPM would approve a probe and its realized counterfactual return is positive after costs.
Opportunity cost is scaled by entry quality, remaining potential and late-entry risk and capped at 0.02 per step.
failure_analysis: The policy still selected WAIT on all 540 deterministic development decisions.
All six development paths accumulated material missed-opportunity penalties but had zero probes, exposure and return.
Increasing the opportunity penalty again is not justified until action probabilities and the training curriculum are audited for a deterministic WAIT collapse.
limitations: Results use synthetic DEVELOPMENT paths from the same generator family as TRAIN.
The failed policy was not admitted to the independent unseen-seed exam.
No SEALED_TEST or real BTC history was opened.
This result does not authorize LIVE, TESTNET or automatic promotion.
